I'm a Business Technology student with a passion for creative storytelling and impactful presentations.

For the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge, We have an innovative, heart-warming concept designed to transform NASA's open data on Lunar and Martian hardware into an unforgettable educational and social experience for young explorers.

Why join this team? We already have a clear, original vision that blends space science with real-world human impact—aiming to stand out in Global Judging!
summary: Space Company is an interactive educational web platform built for children ages 8 to 12 that reimagines real NASA spacecraft and rovers—including the Apollo 11 Lunar Module (Eagle), the Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle, and the Mars Exploration Rovers (Spirit & Opportunity)—as friendly, relatable characters.
details: Space Company is an interactive web-based learning platform designed specifically for children ages 8 to 12. Instead of presenting space exploration through dense technical manuals, it humanizes real NASA spacecraft and rovers—including the Apollo 11 Lunar Module (Eagle), the Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV), and the Mars Exploration Rovers (Spirit & Opportunity)—by introducing them as relatable characters with distinct personalities and stories. ​Users explore the platform through four integrated features: ​Interactive Chat: Kids can converse directly with the spacecraft characters to ask questions and learn real mission facts in simple, engaging language. ​Simulation Game: Players take control of rovers and landers in interactive challenges modeled after real lunar and Martian surface conditions. ​3D Models: Users can rotate, zoom, and inspect 3D models of real NASA hardware to understand how sensors, wheels, and landing gear work. ​Narrative Adventures: Story-driven chapters walk children through historic space milestones from the perspective of the machines that lived them.
